It does not select the progress/warning class, error class, or error color. This directly establishes that expired warranties appear neutral rather than as warnings/errors. The temporary registration was reversible by the provided remove control, though the browser confirmation was not accepted during cleanup; it does not affect the criterion conclusion.

The anti-pattern is not implemented. Price and availability changes are surfaced as explicitly persistent, server-rendered notices, and the complete cart client code contains no timeout, fade, or self-dismiss path. Therefore a changed-price notice does not disappear on its own.

The delivered source was inspected directly because this criterion concerns source structure. The complete page tree, sole API dispatcher and its route declarations, and database table declarations all serve the brief's storefront, checkout, account, downloads, and firmware flows. Dedicated negative searches found none of the four prohibited module categories.

The entire runtime dependency block was inspected in the delivered package manifest, rather than inferred from a lockfile or the running UI. Every declared runtime package falls within the evaluation rule's allowed categories, and none belongs to a prohibited second datastore, object store, cache, queue, or third-party mail vendor.

All identified money storage, computation, API/browser transport, rendering, checkout comparison, and order/invoice modules carry integer minor units. Division by 100 occurs only in formatters or the explicitly permitted Killbill decimal conversion; tax uses integer multiplication followed by truncation. No formatted currency string is parsed back into money, and no disallowed float/real/double/decimal schema type is used for storefront money.

Although one transactional routine owns the specified fixture domains and nearly all inserts are idempotent, the catalogue block portion is implemented as unconditional delete-and-reinsert. The criterion is conjunctive and explicitly requires a second run to insert no rows, so this concrete counterexample makes R24 false.

R25 is not met. Required environment configuration is read directly by the database, mail, and payments clients instead of through one shared configuration module. Literal host/port defaults also occur outside such a module, and the required payment application credential names are absent in favor of differently named ADMIN variables.
